messages.author: 1d8f09b6a62540d7
messages.subject: Shiny Help
parts:
Hello All,
 I am new to Shiny and seek your help.

I have an SAS process which currently connects to Hadoop and pulls out 32 excel samples based on 32 subqueries.

My task is to build an app on R shiny such that I can choose the criteria myself and pull the sample I want to work with.
Basically, create a dashboard which has a field for the criteria and a button to download the sample to excel.

Thanks
Puneeth

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Help
parts:
Hi Puneeth, this group is most helpful when you try to make what progress you can on your own, and then ask for help when you get stuck. You will need to work through the Shiny tutorial at the very least.

If you're asking whether what you're describing is feasible in Shiny, yes, very much so. See the Hadoop section on this page for a pointer to some useful packages for connecting to Hadoop from R. To create download buttons for Shiny you can look at this article.
